tickets.name: Lob City
tickets.note: Knock knock. Who's there? Doncic, Reed, Jackson and Stewart, that's who. First possession, Doncic on the left wing, and he's not here to pass. Here's Reed, crouched and coiled at center court. Up he goes. Jukebox Jackson! Tip goes to the Clippers, and Jackson is rumbling down the lane right behind it. The ref flips it, Stewart flicks it, and the Grizzlies are off to the races. Tougher than a boiled boot! Bless its heart, this ticket's got big dreams.

tickets.name: Transition
tickets.note: Four horses in this race: Doncic, Reed, Sharpe and Carter. They're off! Here's Daylight Doncic. Doncic pulls the trigger first, asks questions later. Rocket Reed, y'all. Jump ball, and Reed plays it like a volleyball spike. Sharpe gets the first touch of the night with his fingertips and the second with both hands. Carter springs off that hardwood like somebody swapped it for a trampoline. Give him the circle and he'll give his team the ball. Nearly every night. Hang on to the railing, folks.

tickets.name: Run and Gun
tickets.note: Ladies and gentlemen, the starting lineup for this one: Sabonis, Jackson, Reed and Jackson! Sabonis rakes the tip to a guard and trots to the block like he owns the place. Bigger than a Thanksgiving ham! Jackson in the circle, the ref tosses it, and Jackson swats it right to a teammate. The ref throws it up and Reed sends it back down to the Pistons with a smile. Jump ball. Jackson wins it, and the Clippers run the first play right back to the paint. Higher than a kite in March! Put it in the oven and let it bake.

tickets.name: Heat Check
tickets.note: It's a four-course meal: Sabonis for the appetizer, then Jackson, Collins and Sharpe. Sabonis squares up in the circle, the whistle blows, and he's already in the air. There's Jackson in the circle, long as a summer day, and twice as hot. Tougher than a two-day-old biscuit! Here's Cool-Hand Collins. Collins gets downhill on the first possession, and nobody's stepping in front of that freight train. Sharpe wins the opening tip and the Nets go right at the rim with him. Oh, that's nasty! It's a lottery ticket with a jump shot!

tickets.name: Buzzer Beater
tickets.note: Holmgren drives, Jackson rides shotgun, and Reed and Stewart fight over the radio. Holmgren rises, taps, and runs. The Thunder have the ball and he wants it back. Big man, big jump, big chance. That's Jackson at the start of the night. Reed times the toss like a man catching the last bus home. Splash Stewart, y'all. Stewart meets that toss at its peak and steers it straight to the Grizzlies point guard. Let 'er rip!

tickets.name: Showtime
tickets.note: Here comes the parade! Holmgren with the baton, Jackson, Collins and Sharpe marching behind. Hurricane Holmgren! Holmgren plants his feet in the circle like a porch post in red clay. Jackson gets a fingernail on the toss, and a fingernail is all he needs. Steadier than a grandfather clock! Collins brings it up, sizes it up, and puts it up. Here's Sizzlin' Sharpe. The toss goes up and Sharpe meets it at the top like they had a lunch date. We're letting it ride, baby!

tickets.name: Alley-Oop
tickets.note: Zubac is the headliner, and Jackson, Reed and Jackson are the encore. Zapper Zubac! Zubac gets up so high on the tip he could change a light bulb. The ball barely leaves the ref's hand before Jackson slaps it to the Jazz. Tougher than woodpecker lips! Here's Reed at the opening toss, long arms, big hands, bigger plans. Taller than a tobacco barn! Jackson gets his fingertips on it first and flicks it to the wing like he's dealing cards. Spicier than a plate of hot chicken! That's a ticket you write home about!

tickets.name: Full Court
tickets.note: Four names, four arenas, one big night: Zubac, Jackson, Stewart and Collins. Zubac taps it back, sprints the floor, and posts up before the defense has tied its shoes. He's cooking with gas now! Tip to the Jazz, a quick swing, and Jackson is sealing his man under the basket. Somebody call the fire marshal! Stewart gets the jump on the jump ball, and the Grizzlies are in business. Mm-mm-MM, that's a good-looking bucket! The Pistons offense opens with a Collins isolation, and he's licking his chops. Put some mustard on that! Somebody get the camera rolling.

tickets.name: Count On Me
tickets.note: Garrett lays the foundation, and it's poured from chalk: Doncic, Sabonis, Holmgren and Zubac. Opening minute, Doncic gets the ball at the top of the key, and it's go time. Hotter than a jalapeño in a sauna! Here's Sky-High Sabonis. Sabonis wins the tip, gets it right back on the block, and goes to work. Here we go: Holmgren versus the other big, and Holmgren gets there a hair early. The tip is where he does his best work, and he does it often. The Pacers send Zubac to the circle, and the circle sends the ball to the Pacers. That jump ball might as well have his name stitched on it. Built on rock, built on chalk, built by Garrett.
